01 SECTORS VISITED

DVD / FIELD GUIDE / REV.17

a few ways in

This is an open-ended field of Dylan van Dael’s work. Each visit begins with a new seed; the drawing continues as you move through it.

DRAG / WASD / ARROWS
Move across the field.
SCROLL / TWO-FINGER DRAG
Pan at a fixed drawing scale. There is no zoom.
hover a project marker
Reveal its name. Click or tap to open it.
tab / enter
Focus project markers and open their projects.
sound on
Hear the drawing unfold. Hover a shape to hear its voice. Open the sliders beside sound to shape its Dorian chord progression and volume. New chord routes emerge with each phrase; melodies follow them and return home. The effects tab adds reverb, stereo delay, chorus and saturation, with a dry comparison.
new field
Generate another arrangement.
COPY LINK
Save the seed, location, and plot settings.

There are seven documented works and project fragments. They recur across the generated field; new sectors do not represent additional projects. Colored paths represent shared sound, image, or object relationships. Yellow paths connect visual worlds; black paths extend the field. Each connection is drawn in a single continuous stroke as you explore.

The independent prototype uses credited images from Dutch Design Week. Each project includes its source. Sound is made from four supplied audio recordings, sliced and transposed to follow the drawing and its Dorian chord progression; it is not presented as a recording of these projects. No fabricated artworks or live performance data.
